findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure use of eval/exec
 * @description Finds uses of eval or exec which may lead to code injection if used on untrusted input
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-eval-exec
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch(".*tqdm.*")
select call, "Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if passed untrusted input."
findings.hypothesis: tqdm may use eval/exec which can be dangerous if applied to untrusted data

message.text: Use of eval/exec may lead to code injection if passed untrusted input.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name TQDM CLI use of eval/exec
 * @description Flags uses of eval/exec in tqdm's CLI implementation, which may be risky if CLI input is passed directly.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/tqdm-cli-eval-exec-context
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python

from Call call, Name callee
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "tqdm/cli.py" and
  callee = call.getFunc() and
  callee.getId() in ["eval", "exec"]
select call, "Use of " + callee.getId() + " in tqdm/cli.py – review how arguments are constructed from CLI input."
findings.hypothesis: Identify the exact locations and context of eval/exec usage in tqdm CLI to assess exploitability.

message.text: Use of eval in tqdm/cli.py – review how arguments are constructed from CLI input.
